definitions.gloss: setting up a meal; laying out dishes
definitions.explanation: The original meaning: preparing and arranging dishes and utensils for a meal.

definitions.gloss: preparation; arrangement; setting things up for someone
definitions.explanation: By extension, preparing or arranging things in advance so that something will go smoothly. Often implies doing the groundwork so that someone else can proceed easily.

examples.japanese: {膳立|ぜんだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare the table / to set things up.
I set up the table before the guests arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{膳立|ぜんだ}て⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{始|はじ}められた。
examples.english: My mother set everything up for me, so I could start cooking right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{膳立|ぜんだ}て⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My boss set things up for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膳立|ぜんだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}った→整う：03935_totonou⟧。
examples.english: The preparations for the meeting are in order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膳立|ぜんだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{断|ことわ}られた→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。
examples.english: I arranged everything for his job change, but in the end he turned it down.

notes:
Compound of {膳|ぜん} (dining tray/table) and ⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (setting up). Originally referred to laying out a meal, but now commonly used figuratively to mean preparing or arranging things in advance for someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膳立|ぜんだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make preparations, to set things up
- {膳立|ぜんだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧: preparations are in order
- {膳立|ぜんだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出来|でき}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: everything is set up and ready

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: preparation — the most general and common word for getting ready
- ⟦{段取|だんど}り→段取り：06629_dandori⟧: arrangement, planning — focuses on the order and logistics of preparation
- ⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧: arrangement — arranging for people or resources, often in a business context
- ⟦{下準備|したじゅんび}→下準備：11301_shitajunbi⟧: preliminary preparation — basic prep work done in advance
